profile.headline: Software Engineer at N Street Village
profile.summary:
As a software engineer intern at JPMorgan Chase, I developed the back-end of a JSON processing application using AWS and Springboot, leveraging Amazon S3 to establish a streamlined data storage system. I actively participated in code reviews and implementation of best development practices, enhancing software development efficiency and project timelines. I also played a vital role in gathering requirements and providing valuable input during team discussions, tailoring the service to meet specific business needs and further improving time savings.

I am pursuing a bachelor's degree in information science at the University of Maryland. I have deep knowledge of the full tech stack, and competency in skills such as object-oriented programming, Java, C++, and Python. I am passionate about learning new technologies and applying them to real-world problems. I have completed an immersion program at the D'Amore-McKim School of Business at Northeastern University, and I am a fellow at Lime Connect, a leadership and professional development program for students with disabilities. I am seeking opportunities to gain more experience in the field of software engineering, and to contribute to innovative and impactful projects.
